fields.raw_text: delete all  references to daily brief

i want to build out the landing page for hopehub. it will have a vis cluster graph for a menu just like aurora. it will have a node for mission_statement and about_hopehub, journal_entry form, life_resources, and login_form. only the journal_entry_form and login_form exist at this time. except for the landing page, the pages that do not exist will have an under_construction view that need end-to-end django functions and mappings: html, urls, and a python script that uses the standard render function.

for the HTML minion i want to add some CONSTRAINTS. 

adopt a lasy-frontend process relying on bootstrap names and classes, and bootswatch themes for CSS styling. only write custom CSS when the out-of-the-box styling is inadequate.

for forms use ModelForms combined with django-crispy-forms.

i want to create a form for new views, tasks and documentation. i want to upload all current docs that are stored as text files an office, and .md docs all over the place. the documentation piece needs to be automated, but until i fully understand what i want to document. i want to create a "Currently under development" placeholder that can be inserted into new views after the mechanics for the page are in place.

fields.text: i feel a little tired. i woke up early with things on my mind. now i'm a little unmotivated. i sort of wore myself out and wish i could just lay down a while. i'm thinking a lot about giving a talk to people about my life.  i'm stuck on the ranch. this is some sort of a validation thing. i imagine that i am well-known for my accomplishments and i'm talking to people who are interested. i guess i need to future-justify my worth to myself.

i woke up around 4:30 and couldn't  get back to sleep. i got up and went upstairs to the kitchen to work and have a cup of coffee. i am obsessed with getting this project to a steady flow state. i feel like it's a lot of little half-functional widgets that don't quite work as planned and aren't connected to each other. quite honestly, it's making me a little crazy.  i have to be mindful that, while it's important to me to do something impressive, it's not the focus of my life. or, it shouldn't be. i have nothing else to spend my time on. or, do i. perhaps i should rethink that whenever i can concentrate on anything other than this project.

i rode the bus to Metropolitan Market to get some coffee. all the way here i was thinking about my motivation for this project an i came up with some goals.

LONG TERM  GOALS: 
to secure my own financial future.
provide for lynn
give aurora and quite possibly hopehub to chris

SHORT TERM GOALS:
find a job that will cover my month-to-month living expenses
find a housing situation with my own room that has wifi

PERSONAL GOALS:
continue my practice of growth and meditation
spend some more time seeing things around seattle
build a circle of friends that share my interests

i am super motivated and pretty content today. i felt like i made huge progress on the project yesterday. it's  not so much the tangible additions to the code. it's more i felt super fragmented and unfocused. i also felt like i didn't really understand what i was doing or that i had a singular focus. i was worried that maybe i was just playing and the project scope had become unmanageable. today i am super clear about things and i know what needs to happen. i am confident that i can make it happen. Delta is back!

i  am sitting in Met Market and i was just about to start typing when my favorite song right now came on. that made pause and listen. then Derrick came by and he informed me that this place has wifi. i didn't think it did, but never checked. that improved my mood a lot. i have been getting increasingly frustrated with the lack of progress on aurora lately, i do feel like the U gives me what i need at the right moment. i woke up at 2:30 and again at 4. i'm desperately trying to figure out how to get this thing moving and see some progress. i need to find a way to get some little wins to keep my motivation up.

i fixed my coffee and i am thinking about where i'm at on aurora. after losing another session day before yesterday, i didn't have the will to dive in again retraining the AI so i took a little time to do some fun stuff. i used genesis to create logos for hopehub and aurora. i'm quite pleased with that. i then refactored the console screen and landing page to use the base html and display them always as a link to the home page. i then began documenting just what the purpose of this whole thing is, tying in the hopehub application as the motivation for this everything. i think i had lost site of that a little. i was so into making aurora a cool, impressive tool that i put hopehub aside. now i see that without hopehub, there is no reason to build aurora. maybe i can use it for something else later, but my mission is hopehub and aurora is just a way to build it by myself. i feel much better now. perhaps the universe was trying to tell me i had strayed from the path. today will be better.

i'm thinking about the project. i need to develop a workflow that allows me to work without interruption. once i feel i am not spinning in circles i can focus on my meditation and personal growth. it is all connected. i have decided to develop a manual strategy for working and then figure out which parts can be automated. it is not wise to try and automate everything from the start. i must start making progress on hopehub and let aurora develop organically. i have a long day today, so i will try to center myself and tackle it in the most efficient way possible.

i am feeling good today. i am trying to decide if i want to go recovery cafe today for my circle. i don't want to. i'm not getting much from it at this point. am i relapsing, or am i just moving on? i do get tired to my whole life being about recovery. i haven't connected with anyone there too much. story of my life. but, i think i will skip it today. this will be my second time in a row. i enjoy working on this beast i have created. i was so frustrated yesterday i thought about scrubbing the whole thing and starting over. i will take another direction. yesterday i used genesis to create an automated feature creator that does not rely on AI for the initial creation of the URLs and views, which will make things go faster. i need to use AI for big stuff, but simple things need to be automated without the AI. AI isn't where i need it to be for a development "partner" yet. but i do need to get back to meditation. i am neglecting my personal growth for the work.

fields.title: HIPAA Compliance and Targeted Encryption Protocols
fields.body_text:
1.1 Regulatory Scope & Intent
The HopeHub platform ingests, transmits, and stores Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA Security Rule definitions. The platform minimizes exposure risks by maintaining strict data separation between administrative metrics and clinical data bodies.

1.2 Targeted Encryption Matrix (Data at Rest)
To satisfy HIPAA 'Securing PHI' standards, the platform enforces an asymmetric storage layout:
 - Clinical Text Identifiers (JournalEntry.text): Encrypted via application-layer AES-256 Fernet ciphers.
 - Analytics Metadata (emotion, mood_rating): Kept in plain text for indexing and rapid dashboard processing.

1.3 Cryptographic Key Isolation Boundary
Field-level encryption utilizes an independent environment variable (HOPEHUB_FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY). The primary web application framework key (SECRET_KEY) is strictly barred from cryptographic data actions.

fields.title: 42 CFR Part 2 Substance Use Disorder Privacy Hardening
fields.body_text:
2.1 Substance Use Disorder Confidentiality Mandate
Under 42 CFR Part 2, records of identity, diagnosis, prognosis, or treatment of any patient maintained in connection with a federally assisted program for substance use disorder are confidential.

2.2 System Enforcement Mechanisms
 - Absolute identity segregation: Patient names and administrative profiles are separated from clinical strings.
 - Explicit Logging Restrictions: Plain-text patient logs are stripped from tracebacks and system logs to prevent accidental metadata leaks during unexpected thread crashes.

constraint_data.crash_prevention: Wipe or clean package references inside __init__.py modules BEFORE clearing corresponding target view content files.
constraint_data.process_isolation: All validation tests must execute via asynchronous subprocess shells with absolute 10-second timeouts.
constraint_data.atomic_transactions: Staged writes use .tmp variations before executing an os.replace swap.
